plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Gives Claude Code a journal of your work, so a new conversation starts where the last one stopped. It keeps long tasks on track when a conversation is compacted, keeps old versions of its notes so a lost one can come back, shares lessons across your projects and keeps secrets out. Everything stays on your computer.
